note: Small modern campground in the woods on the peninsula south of 110-acre Union Grove Lake, plus two modern cabins; the lake is 150-250 m from the sites through forest. --Claude
summary: Fees confirmed ($18-22 electric, +$12 full hookup peak); 20/30/50 amp added; 10 back-in sites to 35 ft (2 buddy pairs); showers/dump confirmed; pin moved ~690 m to the campground; waterfront lead lakeview -> not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN (lead, lakeview -> not waterfront): ReserveAmerica tags every site 'Near Water - no'. On imagery the loop sits in dense forest on the peninsula south of the lake; the nearest open water is ~150 m north or west of sites 10/11 and ~170-250 m east of the loop, all through unbroken woods, so no view from any pad. No official photo seen that shows water. The stored 'lakeview' is not supported; down to not waterfront.
PIN: stored 42.13050,-92.72180 is ~690 m NE of the sites, out in the lake. ReserveAmerica's GIS points for sites 2-11 and H1 average 42.12502,-92.72517 - use that.

SEASON CONFLICT (season is manual, not overwritten): stored season note says 'the dump station closes for the winter', but the DNR alert for Union Grove (effective 10/15/2026) says 'All of the modern restroom and shower facilities are closed for the season. RV dump station and water hydrants will remain on. Pit latrines are available in the campground.' year_round true stands.

SITE COUNT: small campground - 10 numbered RV sites (2-11) per the 9/2025 map, of which 8/9 and 10/11 are booked as buddy pairs, so 8 reservable RV units plus host H1. The stored note's 'level full-hookup sites in the middle (6,8,10,11)' does not match the map (10 and 11 are electric-only) and its 'tent sites sloping on the grassy hillside' are not on the map; dropped.
FIT: driveways 32-35 ft on every public site; all fit 23 ft.
